stem.text: The graph shows the variation of velocity with time $t$ of an object moving in a straight line.

stem.alt: Line graph of velocity in m s^-1 against t/s. The velocity axis runs from -4 to 4 and the time axis is marked from 0 to 32 s.

stem.text: At $t = 0$, the displacement of the object is zero.
What is the displacement of the object at $t = 20\,\text{s}$?
